description: This file defines the enumeration LoanTermFrequencyType used in the Fineract project to represent different types of loan term frequencies, such as DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, and YEARS, each associated with an integer value.

classes.name: LoanTermFrequencyType
classes.description: An enum representing the frequency type (DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, YEARS) with associated integer values used in loan calculations.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the LoanTermFrequencyType enum constant.
